reason: Wrong direction for this category (docs readable, re-opened 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium): 'Yandex Market API for sellers' (https://yandex.ru/dev/market/partner-api/doc/en/; OpenAPI at github.com/yandex-market/yandex-market-partner-api) 'helps sellers manage assortment and prices, process orders, update balances' - its sections are all 'THE STORE'S REQUESTS TO THE MARKET' (offices and shops, products, stocks, prices, orders, FBS shipments, DBS delivery, returns, reviews, chats, warehouses) under seller Api-Key tokens. It is the seller (sales-channel) side of Yandex Market with no API for buying from the marketplace, so this category's supplier catalogue search, quote_shipping and create_order have no counterpart; an adapter belongs with the sales channels.
